Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Access staging plan + API key handoff for EdgePath pilot

Hi Alex — good to meet yesterday. Per our checklist I wanted to lock a short, low-friction plan for the initial tenant and API access so your team can start smoke testing in staging next week. Proposed minimal plan (30–60 minute ops work from your side):

1) Create EdgePath staging GCP project and add one service account (name: edgepath-staging-redwood) — your infra
2) Send service account key (JSON) to us via your procurement-approved secure transfer (we can handle SFTP or HubSpot secure file link) — procurement@edgepath.ai
3) We seed a project namespace and create an API key tied to that service account; we will provide an admin user invite after seed
4) Roles: two admin seats, three dev seats, one observability (read-only) seat

Attachments: I dropped a short checklist (edgepath-invite-rollout-checklist.xlsx) and an example service-account key stub.

Ask: Is this align with your security guardrails? If yes, which day/time next week can your infra owner allocate 30 minutes to create the service account and share the key?

I’ll loop Ben and Monica for the seed and invite timing.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Megan — please chime if Tuesday morning conflicts.

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for looping procurement + Megan. Quick answers below and an attached RBAC seed matrix (Drive link in header):

- RBAC mapping (minimal):
  • redwood_admin — full admin (create models, rollouts, billing view)
  • redwood_dev — generate/embed keys, call inference endpoints, view logs for their projects
  • redwood_viewer — read-only observability (latency/cost dashboards)

- API key rotation: by default we issue a scoped API key tied to the seeded service account and recommend rotation every 30 days. If you prefer automated short-lived tokens (via STS) we can implement that but it requires an additional small step on your side (OIDC trust).

Operational plan for Tuesday 2026-11-30 AM PST (30–45 minutes):
1) Your infra creates service account and shares secure HubSpot link to key — procurement owns delivery
2) We seed project namespace + create API key and post short-lived credentials and role assignments
3) We invite two admin seats and three dev seats (user invites sent to the email list you confirm)
4) Quick verification: run a single inference call and check logs; we’ll stay on the call until success

Attachments: edgepath-invite-rollout-checklist.xlsx (detailed steps), service-account-seed-sample.txt (example stub)

Ben and I will be on the call; Sergio will do the kickoff. If HubSpot file link is the preferred transfer path, procurement@edgepath.ai, please send the link to sergio_alvarez@redwood.com when ready.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
